metadata.notes: This is the author-intended concluding narrative, reached twice with identical endings on branch b0 (e00036, 'in 27 turns') and the restored branch b1 (e00055, 'in 28 turns'). The full treasure route was completed: found the rusty key in the plant pot, revealed the vault behind the bookcase, unlocked the treasure chest with the rusty key, took the bejewelled gold crown, opened the bedroom window and left through it onto the fire escape. The game prints the explicit completion banner '*** You have finished this sample game ***' with the maximum score 8 out of a possible 8. The crown being stolen at the exit (replaced by a golden Minoan sceptre) is the bleak but intended narrative ending documented in the manifest's completion criteria — not a death, quit, or partial score: the player character is roughed up but alive and the game awards full marks. The game then offers only RESTART/RESTORE/QUIT, confirming no further playable content.
